modules.title: 价格规则怎样在不连接支付服务时被单独检查
单元测试为何要缩小范围

items.title: 单项用例专注单一明确的功能逻辑
items.text: 100 元减 20、99 元不减这类边界输入，能直接说明价格规则是否正确。测试失败时，团队先看这段计算，而不用猜测网络或数据库发生了什么。

items.title: 外部依赖要保持可控
items.text: 支付、网络或当前时间会让结果变慢或不稳定时，可以隔离或用测试替身代替。单元测试快且定位清楚，但它不能证明多个系统连起来一定正常。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 单元测试不是“代码少的测试”的统称，也不是完整用户流程。它适合验证一个相对独立的责任；接口字段、数据库写入和浏览器操作的配合，需由集成或端到端测试补证据。

lessonPractice.title: 改了优惠计算规则后，哪项最适合作为单元测试？

options.label: 向优惠计算函数传入 99 元和 100 元，分别断言不减和减 20
options.feedback: 对。它只检查一个明确规则，输入和预期输出都固定。

options.label: 通过订单 API 提交 99 元和 100 元商品，再核对接口返回的优惠金额
options.feedback: 这也能发现问题，但已经把 API 和订单流程接进来，属于更偏集成层的检查。

options.label: 在浏览器分别下单 99 元和 100 元商品，再检查确认页上的最终金额
options.feedback: 它从用户入口检查完整结果，更接近端到端测试；不能像单元测试一样快速定位计算函数。

en.title: After changing a discount rule, which is best as a unit test?

options.label: Pass 99 and 100 to the discount function and assert no discount versus 20 off
options.feedback: Correct. It checks one clear rule with fixed input and expected output.

options.label: Submit 99 and 100 items through the order API, then check the discount in its response
options.feedback: This can find a problem, but it includes the API and order flow, so it is closer to an integration test.

options.label: Place 99 and 100 orders in the browser, then check the final amount on the confirmation page
options.feedback: That checks a complete result from the user entry point, which is closer to an end-to-end test and does not isolate the calculation.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请给优惠计算函数补两个单元测试：传入 99 元时不减，传入 100 元时减 20。不要调用真实支付或网络。改完后运行测试，把结果告诉我。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Add unit tests for the discount calculation: 99 gets no discount and 100 gets 20 off. Do not call real payment or network services; after the change, list both inputs and actual outputs.

learning.assumes: You have seen a function return a result from input.
learning.outcome: You can identify a small responsibility worth verifying alone and know when outside systems should stay out.

modules.title: How a price rule is checked without connecting payment
Why unit tests keep scope small

items.title: Check one small responsibility
items.text: Boundary inputs such as 100 gets 20 off and 99 gets none directly test the price rule. On failure, look at the calculation rather than guessing about network or database.

items.title: Keep outside dependencies controllable
items.text: Payment, network, or current time can be isolated or replaced when they make results slow or unstable. Unit tests are fast and precise, but do not prove systems work together.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: A unit test is not a synonym for any small test or a full user journey. It verifies one relatively independent responsibility; integration and end-to-end tests provide evidence for connections and browser behavior.

distinctions.label: Integration test
distinctions.text: A {c:unit-test} isolates one function or component. An {c:integration-test} checks whether modules or real dependencies cooperate correctly.
